description: Figure and summary statistics: DDB1 vs DDB2 minimum distance and atom contacts to DNA across 20 PDB entries
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt

R = pd.read_csv("ddb1_dna_contacts_full.csv")
sub = R[R.protein.isin(["DDB1","DDB2"])].copy()
sub["label"] = sub.pdb + ":" + sub.chain
sub = sub.sort_values(["pdb","protein"])

fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(14, 7))

# Panel A: minimum heavy-atom distance to DNA
ax = axes[0]
order = sub.sort_values("min_dist")
cols = {"DDB1":"#B4442E", "DDB2":"#2E6FB4"}
ax.barh(range(len(order)), order.min_dist, color=[cols[p] for p in order.protein])
ax.set_yticks(range(len(order))); ax.set_yticklabels(order.label, fontsize=7)
ax.axvline(4.0, ls="--", c="grey", lw=1)
ax.text(4.3, len(order)-2, "4 A contact cutoff", fontsize=8, color="grey")
ax.set_xlabel("Minimum heavy-atom distance to DNA (A)")
ax.set_title("A. DDB1 never reaches DNA; DDB2 always does")
h=[plt.Rectangle((0,0),1,1,color=cols[k]) for k in cols]
ax.legend(h, list(cols), fontsize=9, loc="lower right")

# Panel B: number of atom contacts < 4 A
ax = axes[1]
order2 = sub.sort_values("c40")
ax.barh(range(len(order2)), order2.c40, color=[cols[p] for p in order2.protein])
ax.set_yticks(range(len(order2))); ax.set_yticklabels(order2.label, fontsize=7)
ax.set_xlabel("Protein heavy atoms within 4 A of DNA")
ax.set_title("B. Atom contacts with DNA per chain")
ax.annotate("4A0B chain A: 7 atoms, but to the\nDNA of the OTHER complex in the\nasymmetric unit (lattice contact)",
            xy=(7, list(order2.label).index("4A0B:A")), xytext=(25, 4),
            fontsize=8, arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->", lw=0.8))
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()

print("Summary statistics")
for p in ["DDB1","DDB2"]:
    s = sub[sub.protein==p]
    print(f"{p}: n_chains={len(s)}  min_dist median={s.min_dist.median():.2f} A "
          f"(range {s.min_dist.min():.2f}-{s.min_dist.max():.2f})  "
          f"contacts<4A median={s.c40.median():.0f} (range {s.c40.min()}-{s.c40.max()})")
from scipy.stats import mannwhitneyu
u,pv = mannwhitneyu(sub[sub.protein=="DDB1"].min_dist, sub[sub.protein=="DDB2"].min_dist, alternative="greater")
print(f"\nMann-Whitney U (DDB1 min_dist > DDB2 min_dist): U={u:.0f}, p={pv:.2e}")
print("Excluding the 4A0B lattice contact, DDB1 min_dist range:",
      f"{sub[(sub.protein=='DDB1')&(sub.label!='4A0B:A')].min_dist.min():.2f}-"
      f"{sub[(sub.protein=='DDB1')&(sub.label!='4A0B:A')].min_dist.max():.2f} A")
